property_summary: For any target address and value, calling sendMoney to a contract that reverts on receipt causes the reference implementation to revert (the call fails and sendMoney reverts), while the mutant that removes the revert will instead return successfully for at least some inputs; i.e., reference always bubbles up callee failures, mutant sometimes ignores them.
change_summary: Remove the revert on call failure so sendMoney no longer reverts on a failed call; this changes observable state when target call fails (it will allow completion instead of revert).
